hook: Second one: a furious neighbour storms the fence waving a dug-up rose and yells 'That mutt dug up my roses again!' while Tank freezes mid-dig with soil on his nose. An angry adult against a guilty-looking dog is instant conflict, and the shelter threat lands by second 6.

scenes.heading: EXT. BACK GARDEN — DAY
scenes.look: Bright but harsh midday sun with hard shadows; torn-up rose bed and scattered soil in the foreground; Mr. Hale's tidy garden looms over the fence.

shots.speaker: Mr. Hale
shots.line: That mutt dug up my roses again!
shots.action: Mr. Hale leans over the fence, shaking a broken rose stem at the hole in the bed.
shots.camera: Low-angle medium close-up on Mr. Hale over the fence, fast push-in

shots.action: Tank stops mid-dig, paws in the hole, soil on his nose.
shots.reaction: Tank's eyes go huge and his ears flatten, frozen like a statue.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tank at ground level, snap zoom

shots.speaker: Sam
shots.action: Sam runs in and kneels beside Tank, arms out to shield him.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Sam, slightly high angle looking down from Hale's side

shots.speaker: Mr. Hale
shots.line: One more hole and he goes back to the shelter.
shots.action: Mr. Hale jabs a finger down at Tank.
shots.reaction: Sam's mouth falls open, eyes welling.
shots.camera: Tight close-up on Mr. Hale, slow push-in, brows crashed down

shots.action: Sam throws his arms around Tank and hugs him tight.
shots.reaction: Tank's tail droops, he rests his chin on Sam's shoulder.
shots.camera: High wide shot, boy and dog small beside the wrecked rose bed

scenes.heading: EXT. BACK GARDEN — NIGHT
scenes.look: Dark blue garden lit by warm yellow light spilling from the kitchen door onto the back step, bowl and bag glowing in it.

shots.action: Sam's hands pour kibble into Tank's bowl on the back step, the Iron Paws bag beside it with its label to camera.
shots.camera: Close insert on the bowl and bag at step level, static

shots.action: Tank dives in and wolfs the food down, the Iron Paws bag standing beside the bowl.
shots.camera: Low-angle close-up on Tank eating, bag in frame, slight push-in

shots.action: Tank licks his lips and looks up at Sam.
shots.reaction: Tank's ears perk up, eyes bright and determined; Sam smiles back.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tank's face, warm doorway light, static

scenes.heading: EXT. PARK — DUSK
scenes.look: Cold purple-blue dusk with long shadows for the panic, turning warm orange as the last sunlight hits the ring and everyone smiles.

shots.action: Mr. Hale's shaking hands tear through a bush, a pale band of skin on his bare ring finger.
shots.camera: Insert on his hands in the leaves, handheld

shots.speaker: Mr. Hale
shots.line: My ring. My wife's ring. It's gone.
shots.action: Mr. Hale straightens up, staring at his empty hand.
shots.reaction: Lip trembling, eyes glassy; Sam and Tank watch from the path.
shots.camera: High-angle close-up on Mr. Hale, isolated against the dark bushes

shots.action: Tank puts his nose to the grass and sniffs hard.
shots.camera: Macro close-up on Tank's nose in the grass, tracking

shots.action: Tank digs like crazy, dirt flying behind him.
shots.reaction: Sam's eyes go wide, Mr. Hale turns.
shots.camera: Low wide from behind the spray of dirt, fast push-in

shots.action: Tank pops up out of the hole with the ring glinting in his teeth.
shots.camera: Low-angle close-up, tracking him up, ring catching the sunset

shots.action: Mr. Hale drops to his knees in front of Tank.
shots.reaction: Jaw drops, hand over his mouth.
shots.camera: Medium shot on Mr. Hale, falling into frame, static

shots.speaker: Mr. Hale
shots.action: Mr. Hale takes the ring from Tank's mouth and cups his face.
shots.camera: Close two-shot, warm sunset backlight, slow push-in

shots.speaker: Sam
shots.action: Sam folds his arms with a cheeky look.
shots.camera: Low-angle medium close-up on Sam, static

shots.action: Mr. Hale scratches Tank's ears and laughs while Tank leans into him.
shots.reaction: Tank's tongue lolls, eyes half-shut in bliss; Sam grins.
shots.camera: Low wide three-shot against the golden sky, slow tracking arc

clips.seam: Hard cut to the park at dusk.
